home:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity landscape 16:9 mobile game HOME SCREEN design proposal for War of Words. Reference image is the CURRENT game's style reference only; deliberately redesign its composition into a multi-mode game hub. Preserve the sumptuous ivory stone / brass gold / deep navy / teal fantasy adventure identity, finely detailed painterly artwork, crisp engraved frames, readable elegant serif headings. No phone hardware, no external annotations, no collage. This is a polished straight-on full screen UI mockup.
NEW LAYOUT: modest compact WAR OF WORDS logo centered at top (no Sunward Ruins subtitle), small settings gear top left, small coin balance top right reading 3 240. Beautiful airy sky-city terrace background softened behind UI. Three equally prominent LARGE side-by-side game-mode cards occupy center 70% width and 65% height, with generous spacing. Each card has distinctive rich artwork upper half, a readable navy description area, status line, and its OWN large gold CTA, all neatly aligned. NO dominant standing hero occupying half the screen. 
LEFT CARD: title 'KAMPANJA', artwork original adventurer facing a brass guardian on an ancient bridge, subtitle 'Borbe, oprema i osvajanje sveta', status '24 / 24 nivoa završeno', CTA 'OTVORI MAPU'. 
CENTER CARD: title 'BESKRAJ REČI', artwork floating ivory letter discs spiraling around luminous teal infinity symbol above a magical book (no enemies or combat), subtitle 'Povezuj reči. Obaraj rekord.', status 'Lični rekord: 12 480', CTA 'IGRAJ'. Subtle teal rim glow gives new mode inviting identity without overpowering other modes.
RIGHT CARD: title 'DNEVNI IZAZOV', artwork celestial hourglass with calendar crest and laurel, subtitle 'Ista tabla. Novi izazov svakog dana.', status '120 sekundi • Globalna rang-lista', CTA 'POKRENI IZAZOV'.
BOTTOM narrow utility row: compact icon links 'ARSENAL' and 'UNAPREĐENJA' grouped beneath small caption 'ZA KAMPANJU'; separately 'REKORDI' with trophy and 'REČNIK' with book. Utilities clearly subordinate to mode cards. Make text faithfully spelled in Serbian Latin including diacritics, large enough for landscape phone. Status numbers are illustrative mock data. Crisp proportional border details, no stretched texture, no blur on interface, no tiny paragraphs. Provide only this single completed home screen concept.
play:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity landscape 16:9 mobile word-puzzle game PLAY SCREEN concept for proposed 'BESKRAJ REČI' mode within War of Words. The reference is the existing game combat screen, STYLE reference only. Transform layout into a premium word score-attack screen with NO combat, NO hero, NO enemy, NO health bars, NO arsenal weapons. Maintain its intricate gold/brass trim, deep navy enamel, luminous ivory/teal letter discs, stone terrace fantasy atmosphere, crisp legible serif headers.
Concept design only: endless run where words replenish a draining TIME reserve; finite starting time, no preset campaign ending. Avoid suggesting passive unlimited point farming.
COMPOSITION: small back arrow upper left, title 'BESKRAJ REČI' at top center, pause medallion upper right. Directly below, prominent score '8 420' labeled 'BODOVI' left, an ornate hourglass + '00:42' and horizontal turquoise time-reserve bar in middle labeled 'PREOSTALO VREME', personal record '12 480' labeled 'LIČNI REKORD' right.
Main central navy board is dominant, with exactly 7 columns x 4 rows of LARGE circular ivory or pale teal letter discs edged in fine brass. Board centered and leaves two narrow side panels. Use this exact board lettering row-by-row: M O S T A R E / P L A V I N A / R E K A S U N / D A N J U T R. Highlight ONLY row1 columns1-4 M O S T with a continuous adjacent glowing golden connection. Other discs are quieter ivory/navy, do not copy the combat energy-color symbols.
Above board a slim elegant selected-word strip 'MOST' with '+80 bodova' and '+3 s' shown as a compact visual reward. Below board small readable hint 'Duže reči donose više bodova i vremena.' Left slim information card shows 'NIZ REČI' then '×2' and 4 small gold progress gems, with breathing room. Right slim information card shows 'DO REKORDA' then '4 060'. At bottom two small optional utility medallions 'SAVET' and 'PROMEŠAJ', and a discreet book icon to 'PRONAĐENE REČI'. These are proposed puzzle aids, no weapons, no opponent or campaign level number. Interface should feel calm, tactile and sophisticated, with enough pressure conveyed by time bar. Background is subdued ivory sky-city library with teal illumination, never competing with the grid. Render exact Serbian Latin text, clear typographic hierarchy, no mobile device frame, no explanatory labels outside the screen. A single flat polished full screen design concept, not a collage.
